svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print one piece: a base 150 x 150 x 28.5 mm with two side guides

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5 x 90 x 130 mm on top, 46 to 51 mm each side of the centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plug well, open on top: 58 x 36 x 19.5 mm deep, centred 8 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: behind the cradle centre (toward the plenum).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Receptacle pocket, open underneath: 72 x 50 x 9 mm, same centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Catch slot: 62 x 4 x 10 mm deep, 58.5 to 62.5 mm behind the centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 5.5 mm holes 60 mm each side of the centre, front and back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two heat-set M3 inserts from below for the receptacle flange.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the receptacle screws in from below, then the cradle stands on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the liner floor on four M5 screws through liner and deck, nuts

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under the deck. The pack's plug drops into the well.
